_note: One row per shell. Wave 0 held only the hand-authored flag; wave 1A adds the kit fields. Kit fields (only when tier is not 'none'): tier (none|S|T|O|E), company (a kit file in this folder), ep (the string kit_ep holds, e.g. ca01), chainId (optional, names kit_<chainId>_out; defaults to ep), ambient (two person keys from the kit's staff), stub (the shared stub knot; defaults to ep), setPiece (name in the kit's setPieces, or null), attack (true for a full shell with an attack half: adds the kit_attack_done mapping), stepAway (the row is the one source: written to social.awarenessEpisode.stepAway), stepAwayBark (optional host line on the step-away mapping), override (optional: deep-merges into the kit before building, keyed sources by id and staff by person; a value of null deletes that key; used only to pin a test fixture to its frozen placeholder positions and timings). A row with handAuthored true is never written by a generator (it is touched only by apply_training_room.py). A row with fixture true is a test scenario, not a course shell.

episodes.why: Carries Gwen's optional deepfake demo call (e13_demo_offered, her event mapping and ink knots), which gen_e8_e17_shells.py does not write.

episodes.stepAwayBark: Have you got a minute? Someone in finance just took a call like that one.
